sessions.title: AI on IBM Z: From Transactional Intelligence to agentic workflows
sessions.description: IBM Z clients are embedding AI directly into the world's most critical business transactions — deploying real-time fraud detection, credit scoring, and next-best-action recommendations at the point of transaction, all where the data already lives. Leading enterprises are now going further, building agentic workflows that reason, plan, and act across enterprise systems to automate complex, multi-step business processes with minimal human intervention. This session explores how IBM Z clients are solving real business problems across the full AI spectrum, includes best practices and lessons learned, and highlights why IBM Z is uniquely positioned as the secure, resilient, AI-ready platform at the center of the enterprise.
sessions.speaker: Purvi Patel

sessions.title: Generic Data Architecture, Data Discovery on Z
sessions.description: During this roundtable, we will explore methods for discovering z/OS assets and their high-level configurations. By establishing comprehensive asset visibility, support teams can proactively identify exposures, misconfigurations, and deprecated components to strengthen overall z/OS system resilience and security.
sessions.speaker: Sueli Almeida, Andrew Sica

sessions.title: The Frontier Model Era: Transforming the IBM Z Security Landscape
sessions.description: Frontier AI models are reshaping the enterprise security landscape, creating new opportunities and risks for organizations running mission-critical workloads on IBM Z. In this panel, we will share Rabobank's perspectives on the evolution of frontier models, key security concerns, and emerging governance requirements. The discussion will explore the growing need for AI-driven vulnerability scanning, approaches to planning and prioritizing IBM security patches, and how continuous security monitoring strengthens governance, auditability, and developer professional’s accountability. Join us to learn how leading enterprises are adapting their IBM Z security strategies to stay resilient in the age of AI.
sessions.speaker: Pradeep Parameshwaran

sessions.title: IBM Z Atlas: Understand, orchestrate and prove IBM Z changes with confidence.
sessions.description: See IBM Atlas in action as it discovers and maps relationships across your IT environment, from hardware and operating systems to middleware, software, and business applications. Through a live demonstration, attendees will explore Atlas’s dynamic topology visualization and AI-powered chat experience, enabling users to quickly understand dependencies, answer environment questions, and gain actionable insights. Learn how organizations are leveraging Atlas for change management, audit readiness, application refactoring, business service mapping, and drift detection, while also helping shape the future of the platform through direct feedback.
sessions.speaker: Meghan McGrath

sessions.title: Would You Trust an AI Agent With This?
sessions.description: Experience Agentic AI in action within IBM Concert for Z and see how AI can accelerate problem determination by analyzing system signals, identifying likely causes, gathering evidence, and recommending next steps. Then cast your vote: which step in the problem determination process would you most want an AI agent to take off your plate?
sessions.speaker: Jenee Hart

sessions.title: IBM Vault Premium Package for z/OS: native certificate and secrets management
sessions.description: Experience a comprehensive approach to credential governance on IBM Z with IBM Vault Premium Package for z/OS, which brings certificate lifecycle automation, secrets discovery, and encryption key orchestration together in a single, policy-driven package. Security administrators gain automated rotation for RACF-managed TLS certificates, a centralized encrypted system of record that surfaces unmanaged secrets across z/OS datasets and USS file shares, and unified key governance spanning on-premises z/OS systems and major public cloud environments. The package replaces a fragmented assembly of separate tools with one entitlement and one consistent policy model—enabling every credential across the IBM Z estate to be discovered, automated, and governed. Customers will be able to view and comment on a demo of end-to-end certificate management in z/OS RACF.
sessions.speaker: Chris Brynes

sessions.title: Software Management-as-Code - IBM Z Install
sessions.description: Experience a hands-on demonstration of IBM Z Install and see how software management can be transformed through a GitOps-driven, software management-as-code approach. Attendees will explore a prototype that uses standard repositories to configure, deploy, and track z/OS software across partitions, providing a centralized inventory of what is installed, where it is running, and how it was deployed.

sessions.title: IBM Project Polaris Tech Preview 2.0 and Beyond
sessions.description: Explore how IBM Project Polaris is extending As-Code practices across z/OS, moving beyond isolated configuration tasks to support Networking, Storage Management, Workload Manager (WLM), and other core system domains. Through a hands-on demonstration, attendees will see how configurations and policies can be defined, validated, and managed using modern workflows, with guidance from intelligent automation and agentic AI.

sessions.title: Workload Expansion: The Future of IBM Z and LinuxONE
sessions.description: As organizations seek to modernize and consolidate more workloads within their existing data center footprint, the IBM Z ecosystem is evolving to support new architectures, deployment models, and development patterns. This interactive exhibit explores IBM’s vision for a more secure, scalable, and versatile platform, highlighting how emerging technologies—including architectures such as ARM—can complement traditional workloads and create new opportunities for innovation on IBM Z.

sessions.title: From Client Configuration Data to Simplification Signals
sessions.description: The IBM Z Configuration Collection Program demonstrates how real-world client configuration data can be used to identify opportunities for simplification across the platform. This exhibit showcases how IBM has analyzed customer configuration data and identified a subset of configuration settings as candidates for simplification, helping teams better understand where complexity exists and where focused improvements may provide the greatest value.

sessions.title: What Is Your Mainframe Not Telling You?
sessions.description: Experience Confluent for Z in action and see how IBM Z event streaming through Confluent for Z turns your mainframe from a silent system of record into a real-time source of business events. Through a live demonstration, watch connectors capture activity across CICS, IMS, Db2, and MQ and stream it — as it happens — into the Kafka topics. See how AI agentic accelerators can be used to easily work with the connectors.This booth explores how enterprises can finally make trusted mainframe data available to the AI and decision engines that need it most, closing the long-standing gap between where transactions actually happen and where real-time insight is required. Attendees will gain insight into practical connector-led integration and agentic acceleration patterns while helping shape the future direction of Confluent for Z portfolio using AI capabilities.Visitors will also participate in an interactive activity to identify which real-time business signals matter most to their organizations and where streaming, event processing, and governance can deliver the greatest value. The experience highlights how event-driven architectures, AI-assisted workflows, and real-time insight can help enterprises move beyond monitoring individual transactions to detecting and responding to emerging business conditions as they happen.
sessions.speaker: Anubhuti Kaushik

sessions.title: Streamlining COBOL Modernization with IBM COBOL Elevate for z/OS
sessions.description: Enterprise clients face fragmentedCOBOL modernization workflowsrequiring many hours of setup,specialized skills, and manualcoordination across compilerupgrades, performance analysis, andoptimization.This complexity delays modernizationinitiatives and increases technicaldebt.IBM COBOL Elevate for z/OSstreamlines the entire process with anintegrated, end-to-end modernizationexperience that accelerates COBOLapplication performance, upgradesCOBOL compiler versions, andgenerates actionable modernizationinsights—all within a unified platformbuilt for speed and simplicity.
sessions.speaker: Reid Copeland

sessions.title: Project Polaris Roadmap: Leading to the z/OS Next GA Experience
sessions.description: Project Polaris is shaping the z/OS NextGA experience by moving z/OSmanagement toward a simplified, As-Code, AI-assisted model. This briefingwill show the roadmap leading to z/OSNext GA, highlighting key configurationupdates across a staged model:bringing up a minimal z/OS system,enabling Polaris on top of that basesystem, and expanding toward abootable, standard z/OS imagemanaged through Configuration-as-Code.Specific focus areas include a morecomplete As-Code configuration picturebeyond parmlibs, including WLM,storage, and networking; activeconfiguration/current-state awareness;and agentic assistance to help Chrisunderstand settings, validate changes,and build confidence.
sessions.speaker: Andrew Sica

sessions.title: Z Database Assistant Update and Journey
sessions.description: IBM Z Database Assistant delivers aunified, intelligent workspace poweredby agentic AI to augment databaseadministrators (DBAs) across IMS andDb2 for z/OS environments.In this session, we will provide an updateon the evolution of IBM Z DatabaseAssistant since the June GA release andengage the Council for feedback.The session will cover both IMS and Db2perspectives, including:• Enhancements to core capabilitiesbased on feedback in 2Q.• Sponsor user feedback, particularlyaround installation and configurationexperience• Progress on tooling integration,including key priorities and upcominginvestments• Updates to Db2 distributedconnection management, includingrecent enhancements
sessions.speaker: Sueli Almeida

sessions.title: Part 1: IBM Z Security Transformation
sessions.description: As AI and frontier models accelerate the speed, scale, and sophistication of cyber threats, organizations can no longer rely on isolated controls or human speed response. This Part 1 IBM ZDC session explores IBM Z's security transformation strategy across the entire hardware and software stack, delivering continuous protection throughout the application, data, and platform lifecycle. Attendees will gain insight into a full stack, NIST aligned approach that integrates security, compliance, cyber resilience, and AI-driven automation to identify, protect, detect, respond, and recover at system speed.
sessions.speaker: Bryan Childs

sessions.title: The Geometry of Intelligence
sessions.description: In this talk we'll discuss the advances in the use of math, neuroscience, feedback mechanisms and perception and how this helps us build agentic systems.
sessions.speaker: Donna Dillenberger

sessions.title: Expedite problem diagnosis in Z Operations
sessions.description: Review value provided to organizations when combining the algorithms from Concert for Z with the deep knowledge from IntelliMagic Vision. Review current state of the art and roadmap with end users.
sessions.speaker: Domenico D'Alterio

sessions.title: Bringing agentic workflows to CI/CD with IBM Pipeline Automation for Z to accelerate how apps are built, validated, and deployed
sessions.description: Validate the implementation of cross-application dependencies support across build and deploy workflows​.

sessions.title: Part 2: New product innovation in IBM Z Security SW: A Briefing on portfolio simplification with comprehensive resiliency for the AI age
sessions.description: Building on the strategic vision from Part 1, this deep dive session explores how IBM Z Security software transforms cyber resilience into measurable outcomes. Through IBM zSecure Secret Manager, zSecure Detection, zSecure Compliance, and the newly introduced zSecure Access, attendees will learn how to automate certificate lifecycle management, detect anomalous behavior at machine speed, maintain continuous compliance, and enforce least privilege access across z/OS environments. Together, these capabilities help reduce operational risk, accelerate threat response, simplify audit readiness, and strengthen resilience against AI driven attacks. Interactive discussions and readiness focused assessments will help participants benchmark their organization’s security maturity and cyber resilience posture.
sessions.speaker: Madhu B A

sessions.title: Out-of-the-box-AI
sessions.description: AI that helps configure an IBM Z box upon delivery.

sessions.title: Unlocking IBM Z Data for AI and Real-Time Decisioning
sessions.description: Business focused innovation requires athoughtful data strategy. Factors effectingthis decision on where to maintain data onZ includes• Bring AI into the core• Build a Z-native event access layer thatsurfaces IBM Z data and applicationsignals into Kafka / Confluent, enablingtrusted, real-time business events forenterprise streaming architectures.This session focuses• How AI on Z can simplify interaction withcomplex enterprise data environments,accelerate analytical insights withoutmoving data off the platform, reduce thedependency on specialized technicalknowledge, semantic understanding,and AI-assisted exploration acrossstructured and unstructured enterprisedata.• How to form a business event refineryfor IBM Z that converts fragmentedsystem signals into trusted, actionablebusiness events.
sessions.speaker: Daniel Martin

sessions.title: Agentic Security
sessions.description: Execution-capable AI agents introduce new z/OS privilege-management challenges because they can submit jobs, invoke APIs, modify resources, and delegate work. Traditional Identity and Access Management (IAM) is not enough; each action must be governed across its lifecycle and tied to identity, task intent, RACF enforcement, and audit reconstruction.

sessions.title: Agentic management of infrastructure resources in a sovereign compute environment
sessions.description: As hybrid cloud and AI operating modelsevolve and dominate the IT landscape,enterprises require governed, auditable,sovereign, and policy-driven infrastructuremanagement across mission-criticalplatforms.This collaboration session will driveexploration and co-creation of the use-casesand roadmap for IBM Meridian for Z andLinuxONE. This is an agentic AI-drivenworkflow and knowledge engine platform thatenables intent-based infrastructuremanagement through discovery, simulation,and rehearsal. The collaborative workingsessions will explore how Meridian integrateswith Terraform as an accelerant forInfrastructure –as-Code transformation onIBM Z and LinuxONE. Additionally, anecosystem of IBM Z software and tools willalso be discussed for future integration.We also recognize that customers running IBMZ and LinuxONE environments face the needto modernize operations while maintainingstrict requirements for data sovereignty,compliance, and operational control. We willalso seek understanding of how IBM mustprovide mission-critical environments with thenecessary governance to ensure that AIagents contribute meaningfully, while nothallucinating or making changes that are notconsistent with policy
sessions.speaker: Christopher Byrnes

sessions.title: Advancing Agentic AI Governance with Security, Traceability, and Transparency
sessions.description: In this playback, we’ll present more insight on how governance - spanning transparency, traceability, accountability, and security - can be embedded into real-world Agentic AI systems.
sessions.speaker: Madhu B A, Elpida Tzortzatos

sessions.title: How IBM Bob is changing the game for mainframe developers
sessions.description: AI is bringing massive change to software development across the technology world, but in the mainframe space - the bar is even higher. Organizations need AI that can handle applications that are highly complex, mission-critical, and  involve millions of lines of code and thousands of interconnected asssets.  The good news is that mainframe application teams are first class citizens in this AI evolution with IBM Bob!  At this session we will cover the key technologies and use cases that are available today with IBM Bob and the Premium Package for Z, and we will feature a client story from the IBM CIO team where they share how they are leveraging Bob within their mainframe application teams.
sessions.speaker: Rich Larin
